title: An infinite quadratic APN family with non-classical Walsh spectra
summary: Construct an infinite family of quadratic APN functions in unbounded even dimensions whose Walsh spectra are non-classical.

formal_statement.body: Construct even dimensions $n_j\to\infty$ and quadratic APN functions $F_j:\mathbb F_2^{n_j}\to\mathbb F_2^{n_j}$ such that every $F_j$ has a non-classical Walsh spectrum. Equivalently in the source's correspondence, the vector-space partition associated with every $F_j$ must not be a $2$-spread.

scope.domain: Infinite families of quadratic APN functions and Walsh spectra
assumptions: Every family member is quadratic and APN
Every family member has a non-classical Walsh spectrum
The dimensions are even and unbounded
Non-classical spectrum is equivalent here to an associated partition that is not a 2-spread
scope.unresolved_remainder: The scalar trace-product switching mechanism of the Gold cube is excluded in every even dimension at least ten and does not yield a non-classical dimension-eight family. A qualifying infinite family outside that strict mechanism, or a global impossibility theorem, remains open.
